The dependency `thm-cm-kepler-conic-and-eccentricity` states `\rho(t)=p/(1+e\cos(\theta(t)-\theta_0))`. This item defines `\varrho(\varphi):=p/(1+e\cos(\varphi-\theta_0))`, then [L2] claims `\rho(t)=\varrho(\theta(t)-\theta_0)`, which instead gives denominator `1+e\cos(\theta(t)-2\theta_0)`. Thus [L2] is false in general; Proof 1.1 and later steps use this mismatched phase. Independently checked the current proof and exact suppliers; repaired as detailed in the batch report. The finding is true of the routed post-reader carrier, not of the corrected current carrier.

The linked `thm-mean-value-inequality` states that a continuous differentiable vector-valued function with bounded derivative satisfies `\lVert f(b)-f(a)\rVert_2\le M(b-a)`. That theorem does not establish `2\mu A/9=\kappa/A^2`; the equality follows algebraically from the definition of `A`. The link in [L3] is therefore inaccurate. Independently checked the current proof and exact suppliers; repaired as detailed in the batch report. The finding is true of the routed post-reader carrier, not of the corrected current carrier.
